name: Integrated Positional Encoding
definition: Integrated Positional Encoding (IPE) is a feature representation that generalizes NeRF's positional encoding to allow a region of space to be compactly featurized, as opposed to a single point in space.
summary: Integrated Positional Encoding anti-aliases neural radiance fields by integrating sine and cosine features over a spatial interval rather than evaluating them at a single point.
